Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a diffuse reticulonodular pattern involving both lung fields, and the lower zones show opacification consistent with bilateral pleural effusions (or extensive basal disease), which aligns with the description of interstitial lung disease in option C. Options suggesting upper zone predominance (LCH) or absence of effusion (sarcoidosis) contradict the visible basal pathology and effusions.
